source: randomization_ranges_scene2.json + delays from the real-arm measurement

rationale.delays: real arm 76-110 ms before computation = 2.3-3.3 steps of 33 ms: camera ~26 ms + frame age 0-33 ms (frames 0-2 steps late), servo dead time ~50 ms + inference (commands 0-2 steps late); joint readings 0-2 steps late per the team's report. Each sampled uniformly and independently per episode, ramped in by the curriculum.
